jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

The Team

The Solutions Engineering team at Imprint is responsible for delivering seamless, high-quality partner implementations from scoping through go-live and beyond. We work directly with brand partners and cross-functionally with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to ensure every integration meets Imprint's quality standards and sets our partners up for long-term success. The team is led by our Head of Solutions Engineering and includes four Lead Solutions Engineers who own the technical execution of partner programs.

What You'll Do

As the Senior Delivery Manager on the Solutions Engineering team, you will own the end-to-end delivery of partner implementations, ensuring our brand partners have a seamless experience throughout the delivery lifecycle. You will manage multiple concurrent implementation workstreams, coordinate across internal teams and external partners, and own the technical relationships with our partners.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Expansion and Delivery

  • Lead the delivery of new features, capabilities, and product expansions for existing partner programs

  • Translate partner and business goals into clear project plans, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria

  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives from initial scoping through testing, launch, and post-launch stabilization

  • Build and maintain delivery timelines and status reporting to keep stakeholders aligned on progress and priorities

Stakeholder Management:

  • Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for partner stakeholders and internal teams, aligning product, engineering, compliance, and go-to-market functions to hit delivery milestones on time and at quality

  • Build trusted relationships with partner teams and internal leadership to influence decisions and drive accountability

Technical Coordination:

  • Work closely with Lead Solutions Engineers to define integration scope, troubleshoot technical issues in real time, and guide partners through APIs, payment processing flows, and operational dependencies

  • Develop a working understanding of partner systems, e-commerce platforms, and the payments ecosystem to provide actionable feedback on integration frameworks

Process and Tooling:

  • Build and refine delivery processes, frameworks, and reporting to increase visibility, reduce cycle time, and improve the consistency of partner implementations

  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to drive efficiency across the delivery lifecycle and champion their adoption across the team

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to drive delivery priorities, surface partner feedback, and ensure integration solutions are scalable and aligned with Imprint's platform roadmap

Risk and Escalation Management:

  • Proactively identify delivery risks, develop mitigation plans, and escalate issues with clear context and recommended solutions

Your First 90 Days

Within your first 90 days, you will be fully embedded in the Solutions Engineering team and independently owning a portfolio of partner implementations end to end. You will have built strong working relationships with Lead Solutions Engineers, product, engineering, and go-to-market stakeholders. You will be driving delivery cadences, stakeholder communication, and milestone tracking across your programs, and contributing to delivery playbooks and process improvements that raise the bar for how we implement.

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in technical delivery management, program management, or complex integration delivery, with meaningful time spent in payments, fintech, or financial services

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent, multi-stakeholder implementation projects with a structured and analytical approach

  • Strong understanding of payments infrastructure including payment processing, card networks, ACH, and related systems

  • Experience working directly with external partners or clients during technical implementations, with the ability to navigate both technical discussions with engineering teams and commercial conversations with partner stakeholders

  • Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, and e-commerce platforms

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, with the ability to present clearly to executive stakeholders

  • High level of ownership with the ability to proactively drive priorities, unblock teams, and push programs to completion

  • Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to explore how emerging technologies can enhance delivery speed and quality

  • Experience in co-branded credit card programs or card issuing/processing is a plus

  • Collaborative mindset with a problem-solving approach and strong attention to detail

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

About the Role

This is a founding product marketing leadership role at a legal AI technology company, reporting to the Head of GTM and working directly with the CEO, Product, Engineering, Sales, and customers. You will own how the company explains itself to the world, setting direction and standards across messaging, content, and sales narrative rather than personally producing every asset.

What You'll Do

  • Develop positioning and messaging that turns complex technical capabilities into simple, differentiated customer value.

  • Own the editorial calendar, setting the agenda for what the company says next and when.

  • Build product launch stories before collateral, defining the problem, message, audience, proof, and narrative.

  • Write and edit across all company voice touchpoints: website copy, product pages, emails, blogs, social, scripts, presentations, and sales materials.

  • Partner with executives to turn their thinking into compelling posts, videos, panels, and interviews.

  • Spend time with customers, Sales, and Success to capture real buying language and bring it back into marketing.

  • Direct video and content strategy, deciding what to make, who delivers it, and what the hook is, and present on camera yourself when needed.

  • Create sales enablement materials that explain key products in 30 seconds, five minutes, or a full enterprise conversation.

  • Track competitors and the broader AI market to sharpen the company's positioning.

  • Partner with performance marketing, using what converts to refine the narrative.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, communications, or storytelling roles in AI, enterprise software, legal tech, or comparably complex product environments.

  • Demonstrated experience in law, legal tech, legal journalism, or marketing to legal audiences, with a clear understanding of how lawyers think, what they trust, and how they buy.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment across formats: headlines, product narratives, emails, scripts, and web copy.

  • Proven ownership of product positioning and messaging, translating technical capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions.

  • Experience planning and executing product launches end to end.

  • Experience directing video and content production, including comfort presenting on camera.

  • Ability to develop sales enablement narratives at multiple depths for different audiences.

  • Experience conducting customer research and interviews to extract real language and buying motivations.

  • Comfortable working across product, engineering, sales, and external agencies while maintaining strategic direction.

  • Proficiency with modern AI tools to improve productivity and output quality.

  • Background as a former lawyer turned marketer, legal or business journalist, or performance marketing strategist is a strong plus.

  • Must be based in the United States with meaningful Eastern Time availability and willingness to travel periodically.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $180,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Location

Fully remote within the United States, with meaningful Eastern Time overlap and periodic travel required.

jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Number of Openings: 1

Hiring Priority: Active Hiring

The DCX Client Services - Home-Based Cut & Sew Production Coordinator keeps factory communication, sourcing, quotations, samples, timelines, and project updates organized. Serving as the operational link between Heavenly Studios’ internal team and overseas factory partners, this person ensures that requests are followed through, records remain current, and risks are surfaced before they affect quality, cost, or delivery.

This is a coordination-focused role. The coordinator gathers accurate information, documents communication, prepares clear internal updates, and escalates decisions appropriately.

REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES

  • A highly proficient communicator in both spoken and written English

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Strong customer service orientation

  • Work well with others and be a team player

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Factory Communication

  • Manage daily communication with current and prospective factories and communicate that to the Cut & Sew Specialist.

  • Use Alibaba, WhatsApp, email, and approved channels; send concise requests; confirm important details in writing; follow up consistently; and record each outcome.

​

Schedule Coverage + Risk

  • Support communication across Chinese factory hours and Heavenly Studios’ U.S. hours while protecting quality, cost, timing, and confidentiality.

  • Work a flexible split schedule with dependable overlap on both sides, document supplier performance, avoid unsupported promises, and escalate significant concerns before commitments are made.

Team Updates

  • Give the internal team clear, timely visibility into factory activity.

  • Summarize status, completed actions, confirmed facts, open questions, risks, decisions needed, and next steps; keep communication logs, quote files, factory profiles, and sample records organized.

Project Tracking

  • Keep each project current from sourcing through production and delivery.

  • Update the tracker after every material change; monitor quotes, samples, revisions, approvals, deposits, production, inspection, shipping, and delivery dates; follow up before deadlines; and escalate risks early.

Samples + Specs

  • Coordinate product specifications, sample development, revisions, and approvals. Double check everything with the mockups.

  • Send the latest tech packs, measurements, fabrics, colors, labels, trims, decoration, and packaging instructions; require written acknowledgment; and maintain version-controlled feedback and approvals.

Product Sourcing

  • Find and qualify new factories for apparel, accessories, packaging, and custom products.

  • Search Alibaba and approved sources, compare capabilities, verify requirements, request quotations or samples when directed, and present the strongest options with clear concerns and next steps.

Pricing + Quotes

  • Collect complete, comparable quotations and organize cost information for review.

  • Confirm unit costs, minimums, sample fees, setup charges, materials, packaging, and quoted shipping details; flag missing costs, unclear assumptions, and changes before presenting a comparison.

Factory Tracking

  • Maintain a current record of every factory and supplier relationship.

  • Track contacts, capabilities, products, pricing history, minimums, samples, lead times, responsiveness, quality history, and relationship status in the approved factory database.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, and Business Administration, or any related field.

  • Experience: 1-2 years of direct Promotional, Customer Service, or Order Management role.

  • Language Proficiency:Strong verbal, written, and English communication skills.

  • Working schedule: Ability to work overnight/graveyard shifts in Philippine time or within US operating hours.

  • Technical Skills:Comfortable using Alibaba and WhatsApp for business communication.

  • Comfortable maintaining detailed spreadsheets or databases

  • Experience using Google Workspace is an advantage.

  • Industry Specific Software/Knowledge:

  • Ability to compare supplier quotations and follow written processes.

  • Experience with cut-and-sew apparel, overseas manufacturing, product development, purchasing, sourcing, or production coordination is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with fabrics, garment construction, trims, labels, packaging, tech packs, measurements, minimum order quantities, sample development, production lead times, quality-control terminology, and international shipping is valuable.

  • Experience coordinating factories in China or other overseas manufacturing regions would be an advantage.

  • Experience supporting a United States-based apparel or consumer-products company would be an advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Salary Range: Php 37,500

  • Job Type: Full-time

  • Work Shift: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST (USA)

  • Workdays: Monday through Friday (USA)

  • #DCXWorkFromHome Set-up

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

  • Industry-leading salary packages

  • Permanent work-from-home setup

  • Company equipment provided

  • Government Mandated Benefits Employer Share

  • Internet stipends upon regularization

  • HMO Coverage upon regularization (with an option to enroll as early as Day 1)

  • PTO credits and service incentive leaves

  • Major spring and winter company live events

  • Monthly employee appreciation virtual events

  • Company-provided career skills training courses

  • A company culture focused on your personal and professional growth

WHO WE ARE

DCX stands out as a leading BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) company that takes pride in assisting growth-focused small and medium-sized businesses across the United States to discover the perfect global talent to enhance their teams.

At DCX, our core beliefs center around fostering growth and making hiring easy. We are dedicated to helping business owners, executives, and industry leaders, primarily within the promotional products industry, in their search for superstar team members.

If you are on the lookout for a company that values growth and places a strong emphasis on its people-centered culture, then DCX is the place for you. As we say around here, LET'S GROW!

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

The Operations Strategy Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Tittle: Senior Marketing Designer

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Marketing Designer.

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Designer to work closely with marketing channel owners to turn campaign and creative briefs into polished, on-brand assets across our portfolio of brands. This is a hands-on design role for someone who can move quickly, manage multiple requests, and translate business goals into effective creative across web, email, paid media, social, and sales collateral. The right person is highly tactical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working within established brand systems while bringing a strong design point of view to each project. You will partner with channel owners to understand campaign goals, audience needs, timelines, and performance context, then produce creative that is clear, consistent, and ready to launch.

What You Will Do As A Senior Marketing Designer

Creative Execution & Production

  • Campaign Creative: Design assets for marketing campaigns across email, paid media, social, landing pages, etc.
  • Brief Translation: Take campaign and creative briefs from channel owners and turn them into effective visual concepts and finished assets.
  • Fast, High-Quality Output: Balance speed and quality while managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholder needs.
  • Multi-Channel Design: Create design work across a wide range of formats, including website and landing page visuals, email marketing assets, paid social and display ads, social graphics and informational posts, and presentation or internal support materials.
  • Production-Ready Files: Deliver clean, organized, final files that are easy to use, hand off, and adapt across channels.

Brand Stewardship

  • Brand Consistency: Apply established brand guidelines across all creative work to ensure consistency in visual identity, messaging, and tone.
  • Design Judgment: Use strong design instincts to make smart choices around layout, typography, hierarchy, imagery, and channel-specific best practices.
  • Brand Systems: Help maintain and improve reusable design systems, templates, components, and creative patterns.
  • Quality Control: Review work carefully for accuracy, polish, and alignment with brand standards before it goes live.

Collaboration & Feedback

  • Channel Partnership: Work directly with channel owners to understand the goal of each request, the intended audience, and what success looks like.
  • Stakeholder Feedback: Manage feedback in a clear, practical way by asking clarifying questions, organizing revisions, and keeping projects moving.
  • Creative Recommendations: Offer thoughtful design recommendations when a request could be improved based on brand standards, user experience, channel performance, or creative best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Work: Collaborate with marketing, product, sales, and other internal teams to support business needs across the portfolio.

What You Will Bring As A Senior Marketing Designer

Experience & Background

  • 5+ years of professional design experience, ideally in-house or within an agency supporting marketing teams
  • Strong portfolio showing marketing design across digital channels
  • Experience in designing direct response assets
  • Strong skillset in testing methodology and how it relates to design testing
  • Experience designing within established brand guidelines
  • Ability to take a brief from request to final asset with limited hand-holding
  • Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines at once
  • Comfort designing for performance-oriented channels like email, paid social, display, and landing pages

Design Craft & Tools

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy skills
  • Experience creating reusable templates, components, and design systems
  • Understanding of channel-specific specs and best practices
  • Ability to prepare clean files for handoff, production, or implementation
  • Basic understanding of web, email, and responsive design principles

Working Style

  • Highly organized and comfortable working in a fast-paced marketing environment
  • Strong communicator who can explain design decisions clearly
  • Comfortable asking questions when a brief is unclear
  • Open to feedback while also able to offer a clear design recommendation
  • Detail-oriented, dependable, and able to move work forward independently
  • Practical, solutions-oriented, and focused on creating work that supports campaign goals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for multi-brand organizations
  • Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM/ESP platforms
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email or web design
  • Experience with project management tools like Monday.com, Asana, or similar
  • Motion, video, or light animation experience
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, DALL-E, Runway, or similar
  • Proven experience working with US based business teams
  • Excellent written and communication skills in English language
  • Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks)
    4 Core US Hours Overlap (7:30pm–11:30pm IST)
    4 flexible hours (IST)
  • Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from June 19, 2025. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: 16,87,500 – 23,62,500 INR annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial well-being.

  • Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits.
  • Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity Leaves, and weekly wellness events.

What’s next?

Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Du entwirfst Referenzarchitekturen für Identity & Access Management, On-Prem Active Directory (inkl. hybrider Anbindung an Entra ID) sowie die zugehörige On-Prem-Infrastruktur und berätst die umsetzenden Teams.   • Verantwortungsbereiche / Domänen

    • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Referenzarchitektur und Standards für Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Rezertifizierung, Joiner/Mover/Leaver-Prozesse und privilegierte Zugriffe (PAM).
    • On-Prem Active Directory: Härtungs- und Tiering-Konzepte, Absicherung privilegierter Konten, sichere Administrationsmodelle.
    • Entra ID (Hybrid): Sichere Kopplung von On-Prem AD und Cloud-Identität, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management – als Teil eines konsistenten hybriden Identitätskonzepts.
    • On-Prem Infrastruktur & Netzwerk: Sicherheitsvorgaben für Segmentierung, Zugriffs- und Übergangsarchitekturen sowie sichere Fernzugriffe im On-Prem-Umfeld.
    • OT / Produktionssicherheit (optional, zukünftig): Vorgesehen als zukünftige Erweiterung des Verantwortungsbereichs – Referenzarchitektur und Standards für die sichere Trennung und Anbindung von OT-/Produktionssystemen (Standort Elmshorn) an die IT. Entsprechende Kompetenz bzw. Bereitschaft, sich in das Thema einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein.

    Architektur & Standards

    • Zielbild & Referenzarchitektur: Entwicklung von Sicherheits-Zielbildern und Referenzarchitekturen für IAM und die On-Prem-Infrastruktur.
    • Standards & Vorgaben: Erstellung verbindlicher Sicherheitsstandards, Guidelines und ADRs; Definition von Least-Privilege-, Tiering- und Security-by-Design-Prinzipien.
    • Risiko- & Architektur-Reviews: Bewertung bestehender und geplanter Lösungen, Identifikation von Schwachstellen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen – ohne selbst zu implementieren.

    Beratung & Enablement

    • Fachliche Beratung: Beratung aller technischen Teams (u. a. IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerk, Engineering) zur sicheren Umsetzung der Vorgaben.
    • Tool-Auswahl & Einführung: Auswahl geeigneter IAM-/Security-Tools und fachliche Begleitung sowie Überwachung ihrer Einführung.

  • Erfahrung: Langjährige Erfahrung in Security-Architektur bzw. Identity-/Infrastruktursicherheit mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Active Directory & Entra ID: Tiefe Kenntnisse in On-Prem Active Directory (Härtung, Tiering) und Microsoft Entra ID inkl. hybrider Szenarien (Conditional Access, PIM).

jobs.title: Senior Director of Sales
jobs.excerpt: Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare.
jobs.description:
Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.

As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Director of Sales will lead Propelus' Employer Growth Team, overseeing revenue growth, sales execution, and team performance across Propelus EverCheck and Propelus Immuware. This leader will play a critical role in Propelus' next phase of growth by strengthening operational rigor, driving consistent commercial execution, and helping establish Propelus as a trusted strategic partner to healthcare organizations and clinical leadership teams.

This is a highly visible leadership role with significant strategic importance to the organization's growth trajectory. The Senior Director of Sales will support Propelus' evolving product and go-to-market strategy, including expansion of data solutions offerings and development of a premium nursing-focused module within EverCheck. The successful candidate is a hands-on, values-driven leader who balances strategic leadership with active coaching, team development, operational accountability, and customer engagement.

  • What we're actually hiring for: A leader who can effectively design a process focused on outcomes - supporting the team in sharpening their relationship-focused approach into a self-originated pipeline with full pipeline ownership.

  • Our sellers need to be excellent at proving the value of EverCheck and Immuware as they exist today. That foundation is what lets us introduce a premium nursing module and expanded data offerings without friction.

  • We have real strengths: durable customer relationships, a differentiated verified data layer, and partnerships that open channels our competitors don't have.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU:

  • Have converted a demand-responsive team into a demand-creating one, and excel at building systems and processes.

  • Want to own the sales content requirement, start to finish.

  • Enjoy being part of rebuilding a commercial engine, not maintaining one.

  • A tenacious hunter, confidently forging into uncharted territory and a driven, proactive self-starter.

  • Are energized by leading people with confidence.

Culture matters here, and we're specific about what we mean. We are collaborative, direct, and evidence-driven. We move fast, and we expect people to bring a point of view. We don't confuse activity with progress, and we don't confuse being agreeable with being aligned. This is a high-standards environment with real autonomy attached to real ownership.

THIS MAY NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF:

  • You're looking for a caretaker seat over an inbound funnel. Inbound and installed-base growth matter, but they are not the growth thesis.

  • You're looking for a purely strategic role. This leader will be in deals, on calls, and in the CRM.

  • You need enablement, content, and reporting to arrive prebuilt. Parts of that infrastructure don't exist yet, and building it is the job.

  • You need a fully mapped plan for your first ninety days on day one. Performance decisions, a coverage backlog, and a plan gap are all waiting.

  • Our values and mission aren't aligned with your personal and professional approach. We are values-driven, collaborative, and focused on long-term, healthy growth rather than win-at-all-costs outcomes. Employees are empowered with autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, creating an environment where high performance and work-life integration coexist.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

  • The full employer plan: You will carry the complete employer board plan, not the sum of assigned rep quotas. Where seat turnover or hiring lag creates a gap between assigned quota and plan, closing that gap is this role, not a footnote in the forecast.

  • A team that builds its own pipeline: Move the team from responding to demand to creating it: a per-rep floor on self-originated opportunities, documented territory plans, mapped buying committees, and a coaching model built around outreach quality rather than outreach volume.

This leader owns Propelus' Employer Growth Team across EverCheck and Immuware, including 8 direct reports: territory representatives, an Immuware specialist, and an SMB-focused sales representative.

  • Territory coverage with no dark accounts: Every named account in every territory carries a current, documented disposition (advance, nurture, or close out), with a dated re-entry point where relevant.

  • A forecast the board can defend: You will own forecast accuracy as a personal metric, not a reporting exercise: owning the qualification standard with the team, requiring client-confirmed close dates, and driving down the deal methodology failure rate without shrinking the forecast to make it look clean.

  • Selling materials in sellers' hands: You will own the requirement, not the wish list: specifying what the team needs at each stage, agreeing on dates with Marketing, and escalating when dates slip rather than absorbing the gap, for stage-by-stage selling materials.

  • Performance resolved, not carried: Two current seats need immediate support and both need a clear, written path with dates. You will make those calls early and stand behind them.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 7+ years of progressive B2B SaaS or healthcare technology sales experience, with demonstrated success leading consultative sales motions across complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles.

  • 3+ years leading quota-carrying teams in complex enterprise environments.

  • Healthcare fluency: deep understanding of healthcare buying personas, workforce operations, clinical workflows, and multi-stakeholder enterprise sales processes.

  • Pipeline builder: a demonstrated record of building outbound, seller-originated pipelines inside a team that wasn't doing it before, and the ability to speak in depth to those outcomes.

  • Enterprise health system seller: proven enterprise selling into hospitals and health systems, with credible command of HRIS and EMR sequencing as a commercial variable, not only as an implementation detail.

  • Operating cadence builder: experience building a weekly operating cadence from scratch, including deal reviews, pipeline inspection, forecast calls, territory reviews, and one-on-ones, rather than inheriting and running one already in place.

  • Enablement owner: direct experience specifying and landing stage-based sales content and enablement in partnership with Marketing.

  • Direct on performance: a track record of addressing underperformance directly and on a timeline, including exiting sellers where required.

  • Operational command: strong command of forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, and performance management.

  • Forecast owner: personal ownership of a forecast as a core individual metric, with a quarter-by-quarter accuracy history you can describe and defend.

  • Business case builder: a solutions background, with the ability to construct internal business cases for hospital leadership.

  • Process designer: experience designing sales processes for methodical, detail-oriented sellers as well as naturally competitive ones: able to give a structured seller a repeatable prospecting motion, not just energize an aggressive one.

  • High energy, high pace: visible confidence under pressure. This team will move at the speed of its leader.

  • PE-ready: comfort operating in a PE-backed environment with board-level visibility and short reporting cycles.

  • Curious by default: a habit of asking questions and digging in.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD:

  • Clinical, nursing, nurse informatics, occupational health, or healthcare operations background paired with strong commercial leadership.

  • Experience with channel, reseller, and co-sell motions, particularly around data and API-delivered products.

  • Experience launching a new module or adjacent offering into an existing base while the core motion was also being rebuilt.

  • Experience in a business that carries meaningful revenue concentration in single large deals.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in healthcare and are focused on hiring individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to support us in doing good, what’s human, and making a difference.

jobs.excerpt: Intellect is a global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale.
jobs.description:
Intellect is a global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100+ countries and territories, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at Fortune 500 companies like Dell, Bytedance, Visa, Shell, McDonald’s, and hundreds more, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

We’re looking for a B2B marketer to build and execute programmes that generate qualified enterprise demand, create pipeline and strengthen Intellect’s presence across priority markets.

You’ll own campaigns from idea through execution and follow-up, bringing together events, webinars, partner marketing, email, digital channels and content to reach the right decision-makers and create meaningful commercial opportunities. You’ll also own prospect lifecycle marketing, building CRM journeys that nurture interest and support longer enterprise buying cycles.

Working closely with sales, product and content marketing, and local commercial teams, you’ll translate business priorities into focused marketing plans and drive them forward independently. This is an opportunity to help shape how Intellect reaches enterprise buyers, enters new markets and builds a repeatable marketing engine.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. We’re open to hiring at Specialist or Manager level, depending on your experience and demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver this work.

Your Responsibilities

B2B Campaigns & Demand Generation

  • Plan and execute integrated campaigns targeting priority industries, enterprise accounts and decision-makers, with clear objectives, timelines and budgets.
  • Bring together email, events, webinars, partner channels, content distribution and selective paid activity to generate qualified demand and commercial opportunities.
  • Own campaign delivery, including audience targeting, briefs, landing pages, email sequences and launch coordination, working with product and content marketing and creative support.
  • Test and improve targeting, channels and conversion journeys based on audience response and commercial results.

Events & Partner Marketing

  • Own the marketing execution of webinars, roundtables, industry conferences and other selected events - from assessing opportunities and shaping the proposition to promotion, delivery and follow-up.
  • Develop joint marketing programmes with partners, associations and industry communities to extend Intellect’s reach and credibility.
  • Work with sales to engage relevant prospects before and after events, turning participation into qualified conversations and opportunities.

Prospect CRM & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Build and run prospect nurture programmes across the enterprise buying cycle, including event follow-up, ongoing education and reactivation of dormant leads.
  • Personally manage audience segmentation, email campaigns and marketing automation workflows, maintaining relevant and coordinated communications.
  • Align with sales on qualification, lead routing, handover and follow-up so marketing engagement translates into timely commercial action.
  • Use engagement, conversion data and sales feedback to improve journeys, lead quality and progression.

Market Expansion & Presence

  • Partner with local commercial teams to translate market priorities and buyer insights into practical marketing plans.
  • Adapt campaigns and channels to local audiences, working with product and content marketing on relevant messaging, customer evidence and assets.
  • Build visibility among enterprise buyers by distributing thought leadership, customer stories and expert perspectives through relevant channels, partners and communities.

Marketing Operations & Performance

  • Maintain a clear campaign calendar and dependable execution of recurring prospect marketing activity.
  • Maintain reliable campaign tracking and marketing data, working with sales and the relevant CRM or revenue operations owner on reporting and shared processes.
  • Assess performance through qualified engagement, sales-accepted opportunities and pipeline contribution, using findings to improve campaigns and budget allocation.
  • Build reusable templates and workflows, using AI and automation thoughtfully to improve execution speed and quality.

Requirements

  • An experienced B2B marketer. You have personally delivered campaigns for business audiences, ideally involving enterprise buyers and considered purchasing decisions. We value demonstrated ownership and results over a particular title or rigid years-of-experience requirement.
  • An independent, hands-on owner. You can turn a business objective into a practical plan, make sensible trade-offs and carry work through to delivery without needing every step prescribed.
  • Comfortable across channels. You bring practical experience in integrated campaigns, events or webinars, and email nurture, with the judgement to choose channels that suit the audience and objective.
  • Confident executing in CRM and marketing tools. You can build segments, launch email journeys, configure straightforward automation and use reporting to improve results.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how marketing supports enterprise sales and can explain how your work generated relevant demand, improved conversion or contributed to pipeline.
  • Organised and collaborative. You manage multiple workstreams reliably, take ownership of timelines and budgets, and work directly with sales, subject-matter experts, partners and suppliers.
  • A clear communicator. You can write effective campaign copy and briefs, adapt messages to different audiences and recognise what will resonate with enterprise decision-makers.
  • Resourceful and analytical. You can work with imperfect data and modest resources, test ideas thoughtfully and act on what you learn.
  • Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to help expand access to mental healthcare and build marketing programmes that support meaningful business growth.
  • Experience across multiple markets, or in healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology or enterprise services, would be an advantage.
  • Open to candidates in Malaysia (hybrid), Singapore (hybrid), Philippines (remote) and Indonesia (remote)

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socialsand communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

jobs.description:
Compensation Range:

$97,000 - $105,000 USD

Compensation Disclaimer:
The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director, Development Advisory, we are hiring a Senior Construction Consultant to join our growing U.S. team. As our new Senior Construction Consultant, you will provide independent construction risk advisory and loan monitoring services for lenders and developers across a diverse portfolio of projects. You will conduct pre-development due diligence, review construction drawings, contracts, schedules, budgets, and project documentation, perform site inspections, validate construction progress against draw requests, and prepare detailed reports and recommendations that support lending decisions.

This is a remote role with the expectation that you are based in the Eastern United States near a major airport and are available to travel up to 50% of the time. Travelling to project sites throughout the country, you will collaborate with lenders, developers, contractors, and internal stakeholders while helping to expand our Development Advisory practice and deliver trusted construction insights across multiple asset classes.

What’s in it for you

Complex projects and diverse asset classes. You will advise on a wide range of development projects across the United States, gaining exposure to residential, commercial, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use, and institutional developments. From pre-development due diligence through construction completion, you will apply your expertise across different project types, delivery models, and markets, broadening your perspective beyond a single asset class or geographic region.

A trusted advisory role. This is an opportunity to move beyond project execution and apply your construction expertise in a consulting capacity. You will serve as an independent advisor to lenders and project stakeholders, providing risk assessments, funding recommendations, and strategic insights that influence critical project and investment decisions. Your professional judgement, technical expertise, and ability to identify and communicate risk will be highly valued.

The opportunity to help build a growing practice. As part of an expanding U.S. Development Advisory team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth and evolution of the practice while working alongside respected professionals across the United States and Canada. Whether your career aspirations include technical specialization, mentoring others, business development, or leadership, you will have the support, exposure, and opportunities to continue advancing your career within a global organization.

As our new Senior Construction Consultant, you will:

  • Provide independent construction risk advisory and due diligence services. You will review construction drawings, specifications, schedules, budgets, contracts, development approvals, and other project documentation to assess project feasibility and identify potential risks prior to financing. Applying your construction expertise and professional judgement, you will prepare detailed due diligence reports that provide lenders with a clear understanding of project scope, cost, schedule, and risk exposure before loan closing or initial funding.
  • Lead construction loan monitoring and reporting activities. You will serve as the independent advisor between lenders, developers, contractors, and project stakeholders throughout the construction lifecycle. Conducting regular site inspections, you will evaluate construction progress, validate draw requests against work in place, review supporting documentation, assess cost-to-complete forecasts, and provide funding recommendations that support informed lending decisions. You will prepare comprehensive monthly reports that communicate project status, financial performance, schedule adherence, and emerging risks through project completion.
  • Assess project performance and proactively identify risk. You will analyze contractor pay applications, subcontractor invoices, lien waivers, change orders, RFI logs, contingency utilization, and other key project controls to evaluate project health and financial performance. Drawing on your understanding of construction practices, contracts, and project delivery, you will identify potential concerns, communicate findings clearly, and recommend practical solutions that help lenders mitigate risk and protect their investments.
  • Manage relationships and represent Altus as a trusted advisor. You will collaborate with lenders, developers, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects. As a trusted source of independent insight, you will build credibility through your technical expertise, professionalism, and ability to communicate complex construction and financial information in a clear, practical, and actionable manner.

You bring:

  • The construction expertise. You have a degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience gained through construction, development, consulting, or contracting environments. You bring several years of hands-on experience overseeing, managing, consulting on, or evaluating construction projects and have a strong understanding of project delivery, construction practices, project controls, budgets, schedules, and contracts.
  • The technical foundation. You can confidently interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, and project documentation across multiple disciplines. You understand how construction projects are planned, procured, and executed and can assess construction progress, contractor performance, and project risks through both documentation reviews and site observations.
  • The analytical and risk assessment capability. You can evaluate project budgets, pay applications, change orders, cost-to-complete forecasts, and supporting documentation to identify risks and assess project health. You apply sound professional judgement when making recommendations and understand the potential impact of cost, schedule, scope, and construction-related issues on project outcomes and lending decisions.
  • The communication and stakeholder management skills. You can build credibility with lenders, developers, contractors, consultants, and project teams. You are comfortable leading conversations, asking thoughtful questions, and translating complex construction information into clear, concise reports and actionable recommendations for a variety of audiences.
  • The independence and accountability. You thrive in a remote environment where autonomy, organization, and responsiveness are essential. You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, balance travel with competing priorities, and take ownership of your work while maintaining the professionalism, attention to detail, and client service expected in a consulting environment.

Apply now

While specific qualifications may be strictly required, others can be based on various experiences, backgrounds, and knowledge. We can't promise an interview, but we will consider your whole application.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Director, Development Advisory focused on your construction experience, ability to assess project risk, understanding of construction contracts, schedules, budgets, and project controls, and your approach to construction loan monitoring and lender advisory services. The discussion will also explore your experience working independently, managing multiple projects, and communicating with a variety of project stakeholders.

Unlock your Altus Experience!

If you’re looking to advance your career in in an industry that is transitioning for greatness, there’s no better place than Altus Group.

Our high trust, high performance culture prioritizes progressive programs that empower you to deliver your greatest performance while promoting collective success where everyone is recognized and connected.

We offer boundless opportunities in a rapidly growing global business: mentorship from the best and brightest in CRE, access to our Altus Intelligence Academy, and the chance to work with the best data sets, tools and technology in the industry.

What Altus Group offers:

  • Rewarding performance: competitive compensation, incentive and bonus plans, and a total rewards package prioritizing mental, physical, and financial well-being.

  • Growth and development: we invest in your professional learning. Our Altus Intelligence Academy offers over 150,000 hours of learning content.

  • Flexible work model: our Activity-Based Work model provides flexibility to align your work location to the needs of the work — use the office for collaboration and remote work for focused tasks.

Altus Group is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all clients and employees feel welcomed, accepted and valued. Applicants with disabilities may contact Altus Group to request and arrange for accommodations.If you need accommodation, please contact us at or +1 888 692 7487.

AI tools may be used to support the initial stages of screening for this role; however, all assessments and final hiring decisions are reviewed and made by an Altus Group hiring professional.

Background Checks

Please note that as part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, Altus Group may conduct background checks on candidates who receive a conditional offer of employment. These checks may include, but are not limited to, verification of employment history, education credentials, criminal records, credit history (where relevant), and reference checks. The scope and nature of background checks may vary depending on the role, location, and applicable laws. All background checks will be conducted in compliance with local laws and regulations, and candidates will be informed of any checks required as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.excerpt: Who is PawaPayPawaPay is a pan-African fintech enabling local payment channels used by the mass market to both local and international merchants.
jobs.description:
Who is PawaPay

PawaPay is a pan-African fintech enabling local payment channels used by the mass market to both local and international merchants. We operate in a highly regulated, partner-driven environment and are in scale-up mode, with ambitious growth plans across multiple African markets.

Our vision is to simplify business for companies and consumers in Africa and we do that by ensuring that payments simply work, at scale, despite fragmentation and complexity that exists on the Continent.

Through our payments API we already facilitate over 4 million transactions a day across 20 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. We are the largest PSP on the Continent for the processing of mobile money payments, and have positioned ourselves well to lead the payment space as it grows over the next decade.

At PawaPay, there is an entrepreneurial spirit coupled with a modern and professional working culture. The fast-paced, ever-changing environment will suit someone who can adapt and think on their feet. In return, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a group of dedicated and smart individuals working towards the same mission. We work as a remote team and have team members in Europe, Africa and Asia.

The role

We are introducing a single, disciplined way of running cross-functional projects: clear ownership, one source of truth, and reliable visibility. This is the role that makes it work. You will own the delivery system across the business — intake, coordination, visibility, prioritisation support and escalation — while the teams who do the work retain ownership of their own projects.

This is deliberately a standalone senior role reporting to the COO. It is not the head of a Project Management Office and it is not the first hire of a growing PMO. There is no team to build and no governance bureaucracy to stand up. We are looking for a strong operator who runs a system and drives discipline, not an empire-builder. The core delivery workspace is in the process of being launched in ClickUp and an MVP will be in initial use when you join; your job is to run it, refine it, and make it indispensable — not to build it from a blank page.

What you are accountable for;

You are accountable for the integrity of the delivery system and for ensuring that no delivery risk reaches leadership without warning.

In practice, the principle is simple: no surprises, not no slips. Projects will slip — often for external reasons we do not control. If a project slips and leadership saw it coming and made a conscious call, you have done your job. If a project slips and it blindsides us, that is a failure of the role, whatever the underlying cause. You surface risk early and clearly; the authority to act on it sits with line managers and the executive.

You are not accountable for the delivery outcome of any individual project. Accountability for delivery is held at task level by the person who owns each task, and overall project ownership stays with the intake owner (Sales Executive, Account Manager or Functional Lead). You are the framework and the safety net, not a substitute driver.

What you own day to day

  • Intake. The integrity of the intake process — ensuring every project enters with a clear, complete brief and a named owner before work begins, and that the AI-assisted intake tooling is used and kept useful.
  • Single source of truth. Keeping a single, trusted, centralised view of every project in ClickUp, so that business owners and leadership never need to request an ad hoc status update and no team needs its own shadow tracker.
  • Prioritisation support. Supporting leadership dialogue on prioritisation and bottleneck management — preparing the portfolio view, helping facilitate the session, and ensuring it produces a force-ranked list with an explicit de-prioritised column that is logged and communicated.
  • Escalation. Spotting blockers and stalling tasks early, flagging them to the responsible line manager within the agreed window, and escalating to the COO where they are not resolved.
  • Cross functional bridge. Maintaining a clean interface with different departments within the organisation, ensuring fast alignment, clarity on project deliverables and timelines, and efficient delivery across the organisation at large. Build fantastic relationships with all collaborators in the organisation, encouraging their collaboration and buy in on project management activities.
  • Active coordination. Actively coordinating the highest-priority projects hands-on, while ensuring the rest run correctly through the framework via their owners.
  • Reporting and AI. Stewarding the AI-assisted intake and reporting capability, and turning the maintained ClickUp data into the business reports and dashboards as necessitated by business owners. Adopting an AI first mindset as we optimise and improve the way in which we run cross functional projects.
  • Improvement. Refining the delivery framework and ClickUp workspace as real use exposes what needs to change — continuous, pragmatic improvement, never process for its own sake.

What you do not own

To keep the role sharp, it is as important to be clear on what sits outside it:

  • Delivery outcomes of individual projects — these sit with task owners and intake owners.
  • Line management of delivery teams — tool discipline and performance are enforced by each person’s own line manager, not by you.
  • Product and Engineering roadmaps, workflows or daily task management.
  • Building a PMO, hiring a team, or introducing governance gates. Possible growth on our project management team is a future decision for the COO, contingent on evidence — not an expectation of this role.

How the role is measured

You will be measured on the health of the delivery system and on early warning, not on outcomes you do not control. The primary measures are:

  • Early risk surfacing. Surprise rate — missed commitments that reach leadership with no prior formal flag (target: zero).
  • Trusted visibility. Shadow trackers retired and ad hoc status requests to teams eliminated.
  • Escalation working. Blocker age and share of escalations actioned within the agreed window.
  • Prioritisation calls are clear. We have a clear view on priority decisions made and a known understanding of what we are de-prioritising when prioritising new initiatives.
  • Intake quality. Projects entering with a complete brief and named owner; low rate of major scope rework after kickoff.

These measures tighten over the first months as flow builds and a baseline is established. Internal cycle time — time spent in the stages PawaPay controls, measured separately from external wait — is the initiative’s longer-term north star that this role stewards, reviewed at six months. Alongside the metrics, success means the teams who do the work experience you as someone who makes their projects easier, not as overhead who chases them.

What we are looking for

  • Experience. Significant experience delivering and coordinating complex, cross-functional projects — ideally in fintech, payments, or another regulated, partner-dependent environment.
  • Operator, not administrator. A track record of bringing order to ambiguity: standing up ways of working, driving adoption, and holding discipline without formal authority over the people involved.
  • Tooling and AI. Fluency with ClickUp (or a comparable platform) and Slack, plus confidence with Google Workspace. AI-native in how you work — you use tools like Claude to reduce manual effort, not to replace judgement.
  • Domain. Experience delivering merchant integrations, client onboarding or API implementation projects is highly desirable; experience across multiple African markets is a plus.
  • Method. Relevant certification (PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, Scrum) is welcome but secondary to demonstrated ability to make delivery work in a fast-moving, dependency-heavy business.

Key competencies

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influence without authority.
  • Strong cross-functional coordination.
  • Sharp risk anticipation and problem-solving.
  • Clear, credible communication with everyone from specialists to the executive team.
  • Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environment.
  • A genuine bias toward ownership and toward keeping processes proportionate.

Why PawaPay?

  • Help improve financial access in Africa
  • Being part of an amazing team that shapes company’s culture as a great place to be
  • An ambitious, talented, and diverse team who always has your back
  • We grow fast, and you will grow fast with us
  • Competitive remuneration
  • 35 days of paid leave per year (inclusive of public holidays) and more.

Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

  • Process:

  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.

U nas otrzymasz:

Jak wygląda dzień pracy?

Nasi pracownicy to pasjonaci kawy. :) Jesteśmy pierwszym punktem kontaktu dla wszystkich użytkowników technologii w Tchibo. Pomagamy pracownikom sklepów oraz centrali - rozwiązujemy ich problemy z oprogramowaniem i sprzętem IT, dbając o płynność ich codziennej pracy. Stale się rozwijamy, jesteśmy nastawieni na wzajemne wsparcie i dzielenie się wiedzą! Do naszych zadań należą:

  • Odpowiadanie na wewnętrzne zapytania pracowników sklepów oraz centrali Tchibo.
  • Identyfikowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów IT.
  • Analizowanie sytuacji pod kątem występowania anomalii.
  • Zgłaszanie pozostałych problemów technicznych (Hardware / Software).

  • Umiejętność słuchania i czytania ze zrozumieniem, tworzenia jasnych wypowiedzi z szacunkiem do drugiej osoby.
  • Gotowość do pracy w systemie zmianowym (zmiany w przedziale godz. 7:00 - 22:30).
  • Mile widziane doświadczenie w obszarze Service Desk / obsłudze klienta.

Z doświadczenia wiemy, że kandydaci, którzy mają kompetencje, mają także tendencję do zaniżania oceny swoich umiejętności. Dlatego daj sobie szansę i aplikuj!

O nas

W Transcom jesteśmy nieustannie zaangażowani w relacje między sobą i naszymi klientami. Każdego dnia ktoś nowy zaczyna z nami przygodę i wykorzystuje swój potencjał, przekształcając go w umiejętności przyszłości. Doceniamy ciężką pracę, grę zespołową i wzajemną pomoc, wspieramy pozytywne i trwałe zmiany. Tacy właśnie jesteśmy, dbamy o siebie i od samego początku sobie kibicujemy, a przy odpowiednim nastawieniu nie ma przed nami ograniczeń i możemy zajść naprawdę daleko.
